title: Electric Utility Rate Tariff Extraction Schema
description: Extract electric rate schedules and riders with essential fields only. SCOPE: Residential, commercial, industrial electric rates AND all applicable riders. EXCLUDE: Gas, water, telecommunications, fee schedules, terms/conditions without rates

utility_info.description: Essential utility context (repeated for each charge row during compilation)

tariff_book_name.description: Tariff book name (e.g., 'COLO. PUC No. 8 Electric'). Null if not specified

effective_date.description: Date tariff became effective in YYYY-MM-DD format. Convert from any format (e.g., 'January 1, 2024' → '2024-01-01'). Null if not stated

revision_date.description: Most recent revision date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if not stated

rate_schedules.description: ALL rate schedules AND riders - each as separate entry. Extract EVERY base schedule (R, RD, RE-TOU, C, C-TOU, SG, etc.) AND every rider (Fuel Adjustment, DSM, RES, Rider A-J, PCA, FCA, etc.). Each rider gets is_rider=true. Most tariffs have 15-30+ entries. EXCLUDE ONLY: Fee schedules and terms/conditions without rates

rate_name.description: Rate schedule name exactly as written (e.g., 'Schedule R', 'Fuel Adjustment Rider')

is_rider.description: True=rider/adjustment (Fuel Adjustment Rider, DSM Rider, Rider A, PCA, etc.), False=base rate (Schedule R, Rate C-TOU, etc.), Null=unclear

sector.description: Customer sector: 'Residential', 'Commercial', 'Industrial', etc. Null if not specified

applicable_riders.description: CRITICAL: List ALL riders/adjustments applying to this schedule. Search the ENTIRE rate schedule section for 'ADJUSTMENTS', 'APPLICABLE RIDERS', 'RATE ADJUSTMENTS' headings (usually near the end). EXAMPLE from real tariff: Text says 'This rate schedule is subject to all applicable Electric Rate Adjustments...for the DSCMA, PCCA, TCA, ECA, and TEPA Non-Base Rate Adjustments' → Extract: ['DSCMA', 'PCCA', 'TCA', 'ECA', 'TEPA']. Extract EVERY acronym/name from comma-separated lists. Include abbreviations (DSM, FAC, PCA, RES, FCA) AND full names (Fuel Adjustment Clause, Renewable Energy Standard). Null ONLY if no adjustments section exists

rate_calculation_formula.description: How to calculate total rate/bill including ALL charges AND riders. Format: 'Total = [Base Charges] + [All Riders]'. IMPORTANT: If applicable_riders field is populated, MUST include those riders in the formula. Examples: 'Total = Customer Charge + Energy Charge + DSCMA + PCCA + TCA + ECA + TEPA' or 'Total = Customer Charge + Sum(On-Peak kWh × On-Peak Rate + Off-Peak kWh × Off-Peak Rate) + Fuel Adjustment Rider + DSM Rider'. List all charge types found in the charges array, then add all riders from applicable_riders. Null if cannot determine

charges.description: All charges for this schedule (each becomes one compiled row)

charge_description.description: Specific charge name from tariff. Null if not provided

rate.description: Rate value (number for fixed, string for variable). Null if not applicable

unit.description: Unit exactly as written (e.g., '$', '$/kWh', '$/kW'). Null if not applicable

rate_structure.description: Rate structure: 'Flat', 'Tiered', 'Time-of-use', 'Seasonal'. Null if not applicable

season.description: Season name exactly as written (e.g., 'Summer', 'Winter'). Null if not seasonal

season_months.description: Month range exactly as written (e.g., 'June 1 - September 30'). Null if not applicable

time_period.description: Time-of-use period (e.g., 'On-Peak', 'Off-Peak', 'Mid-Peak'). Null if not TOU

time_range.description: Clock hours exactly as written (e.g., '7:00 AM - 11:00 PM'). Null if not applicable

tier_min_kwh.description: Minimum kWh for tiered rate. Null if not tiered

tier_max_kwh.description: Maximum kWh for tiered rate. Null if not tiered

measurement_period.description: How demand is measured (e.g., '15-minute interval'). Null if not applicable

conditions.description: Special conditions for this charge. Null if none

extracted_text.description: Complete charge text verbatim from tariff - CRITICAL FOR QA/QC
